hooks.command: node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8');const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input?.file_path||'')" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && cd /projects/expense-tracker && pnpm prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8');const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input?.file_path||'')" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false pnpm eslint --fix "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
